decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1014/05 B Received 10/05/2011)  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the commercial unit at ground floor of 68 Kingsley Road.
description: Erection of extension to rear roof slope to first floor flat, installation of roof light to front roof slope, external alterations to south elevation of building, and erection of detached single storey outbuilding at the back of premises.
